device.model: Unitree Go1 with CHAMP kinematics in Gazebo
device.name: Unitree Go1 Gazebo simulation (taucrates)

facts.text: The README states that the repository simulates the Unitree Go1 in Gazebo using the configuration from champ_setup_assistant and kinematics generated by the champ package, with a Hokuyo laser and a RealSense installed.
The README states that the package is tested on Ubuntu 20.04 with ROS Noetic.
The README lists Champ, Yocs velocity smoother, the edited RealSense Gazebo plugin, the RealSense description, Scan Tools and a modified slam_gmapping as required workspace dependencies.
The README's Gazebo example spawns unitree_go1 and states that it has a Hokuyo laser and a RealSense installed.
go1_simulation.launch sets use_sim_time true and includes bringup.launch and gazebo.launch.
gazebo.launch includes the external gazebo_ros empty_world.launch and forwards a paused launch argument to it.
gazebo.launch spawns the robot model from robot_description with gazebo_ros spawn_model, loads the ros_control configuration and spawns the joint_states and joint_group_position controllers.

The velocity_smoother launch names the relative cmd_vel raw and robot command topics, the cmd_vel/smooth intermediate topic and the odom topic, and includes the external yocs_velocity_smoother launch.
navigate.launch remaps the laser scan matcher's scan, odom and vel topics to scan, odom and cmd_vel.
The Hokuyo xacro declares a ray sensor with 800 horizontal samples over -3.1415926535897 to 3.1415926535897 rad, and a range of 0.45 to 20 m with 0.01 m resolution.
The Hokuyo xacro loads libgazebo_ros_laser.so with topicName scan and frameName set from the laser name, at update_rate 20.
The gazebo xacro declares an IMU sensor with topicName trunk_imu and updateRateHZ 1000.

The gazebo xacro declares a depth camera sensor at update_rate 20 with a 640 by 480 image, and the plugin names /camera_link/color/image_raw, /camera_link/depth/image_raw and /camera_link/depth/points.

The ros_control configuration declares a joint_state_controller at publish_rate 30 and a joint_group_position_controller of type effort_controllers/JointTrajectoryController for the twelve leg joints.
The CHAMP gait configuration records max_linear_vel_x 0.5, max_linear_vel_y 0.25 and max_angular_vel_z 1.0 as gait parameters; it states no signed /cmd_vel acceptance envelope.
The gait_config header repeats MAX_LINEAR_VELOCITY_X 0.5, MAX_LINEAR_VELOCITY_Y 0.25 and MAX_ANGULAR_VELOCITY_Z 1.0 as CHAMP gait constants; they are not a ROS command contract.

determinism.notes: Event-driven rosbridge fake with no Gazebo physics, CHAMP gait, ray sensor, state integration, camera or wall-clock pacing; placeholder observations do not establish trajectory or state-hash replay

fidelity.engine: analytic:ROS-free rosbridge contract stand-in (no Gazebo physics)
gaps: the fake is a ROS-free analytic contract stand-in, not a recording of captured traffic: it runs no Gazebo, gazebo_ros plugins, CHAMP controller, laser sensor, depth camera or ROS graph
the /scan sample is three placeholder ranges; the pinned ray sensor is configured for 800 samples over -3.1415926535897 to 3.1415926535897 rad at 20 Hz
the /cmd_vel publication is recorded by the fake; no base, leg joint or physics state moves
the depth camera, IMU, odometry, TF, contact sensors, move_base, AMCL and gmapping are not exposed by this package

the pinned tree declares no fully qualified ROS message type, so the conventional geometry_msgs/Twist and sensor_msgs/LaserScan names used by the bindings are not verified by the upstream source and G7 reports ROS_TYPE_NOT_UPSTREAM
the pinned tree exposes no acknowledged ROS stop, pause or reset service or action; G6 reports the missing safe state

the bridge refuses non-finite numbers, so a scan that carries inf or NaN ranges is refused rather than returned; whether the external gazebo_ros laser plugin publishes such values for samples without a return is not shown in the clone

a live run requires the operator's ROS Noetic workspace, the external champ, yocs_velocity_smoother, gazebo_ros, realsense and scan-matcher packages, Gazebo, the launch files and rosbridge; none is started or validated here

safe_state.description: No acknowledged safe state is declared: the pinned tree exposes no ROS stop, pause or reset service or action. The paused launch argument in gazebo.launch:6,21 is a launch-time option forwarded to the external gazebo_ros empty-world launch, not a runtime endpoint; a zero-Twist publication is transmission only. The package is blocked rather than claiming a stop.
